exploratory_status: Post-main mechanism-identification follow-up prompted by observed repertoire dilution; not a preregistered confirmation.
model_scope: Independent binary-fact cultural learning only; no demography, fitness, reproduction weighting, selection, cooperation, or combinatorial reasoning.

teacher_filter_definition.random: One random prior-generation adult; b=0 returns no testimony.
teacher_filter_definition.confidence_ge_2: Uniformly sample among prior-generation adults with abs(b_context)>=2; if none exist, return no testimony. Correctness is unavailable to selection.
teacher_filter_definition.caveat: The confidence filter searches the full cohort without time, mortality, or opportunity cost. Candidate-pool fraction, search availability, and actual endorsements are reported so this advantage is not interpreted as free-search optimality.

common_random_numbers.description: Within each D/seed block, teacher-filter pairs share truths, flip masks, sampled contexts, teacher-choice variates, cue uniforms, acceptance/override/tie uniforms, and adult audit uniforms.

metric_definitions.qualifying_pool_fraction_mean: Mean fraction of prior adults satisfying abs(b_context)>=2 for the encountered context, reported for both filters.
metric_definitions.search_availability_rate: Fraction of social encounters for which at least one abs(b_context)>=2 adult exists.
metric_definitions.qualifying_pool_wrong_share: Mean share of qualifying adults whose sign is wrong, conditional on an available pool; never used for selection.
metric_definitions.actual_endorsements: Number of encounters returning a nonzero selected adult sign.
metric_definitions.advice_accuracy_conditional: Correct selected signs divided by actual endorsements; absent when no endorsement is available.
metric_definitions.private_accuracy: Raw private-ledger correctness with u=0 scored 0.5.

matched_cue_quality.description: Common uniform cue draws give nested correct-cue sets across p.
